balls.text: What a grab! Flying Jitesh ends PBKS' innings. Length ball around off, Omarzai backs away and looks to go big over the on side. Gets a thick outside edge that seems to be flying over the wicketkeeper's right. But Jitesh, despite his body weight going to his left, leaps full-stretch to his right and it sticks. PBKS are bowled out for 101, ten runs lesser than what they had defended earlier this season against KKR here
Length ball outside off, punched to mid-off
Fierce bumper and Jamieson gets it away! It was aimed at his head, he looks to pull but then takes evasive action. Looked like it came off his gloves but it is given as leg-byes
Fuller on off, defensively pushed to Shepherd

Chopped on! A painful end to Brar's stay. Back of a length on leg, he backs away to steer it to third. But it kept coming back in and climbed on him. Brar couldn't do much as it went of his left elbow to uproot off stump
Full on leg, flicked through midwicket
Edged and flies away to the boundary. Back of a length bowled from wide of the crease, Omarzai gets on his toes to flay it away but it goes through the vacant slip cordon
Another wrong'un that draws Brar forward and beats his outside edge
On a length outside off, 99kph, he goes for the cut but misses
Fuller on middle, clipped through mid-on
Huge strike! Tossed up around off, Omarzai gets down on his knee and swings across the line with the turn. Clears deep midwicket easily
Googly, full on off, he prods forward and defensively steers it wide of Agarwal at slip
Shortish and spinning away, he goes back to slap it to deep cover-point
Back of a length outside off, he sways away to leave it be
Back of a length slanting away, gets it off the outer half towards deep third
Short and angling in, doesn't connect the pull through midwicket
Length ball outside off, slashed past backward point for a couple
Banged short and angled in, he ducks to let it be
Angling away from a length, punched to deep cover
Fuller outside off, driven just wide of cover, where Patidar gets around, slides and denies the single
The legspinner turning in from a length from outside off, he goes back to punch it to cover

Celebrappeal from Suyash but umpire Gough is unmoved! RCB review now. He bowls another googly that lands on a length on leg. Brar prods forward to defend but is beaten on the inside and is hit on the back leg. Did it land in line? Nope. Pitching outside leg and RCB lose something for the first time tonight - a review

Wrong proves right for Suyash! PBKS' last hope falls. Stoinis chooses to attack the wrong ball, dare I say, the wrong bowler, too. Nicely tossed up around off, it lands on off, Stoinis, to be fair, picks it early and looks to hack it with the turn over midwicket. But it spins past the inside edge and makes a mess of the stumps. The evening only gets better for Suyash and RCB
Fuller wrong'un, eased down to long-on
Quicker length ball on the pad, he misses the tuck and it goes off his pad towards square leg. Kohli sprints to it, fires a throw at the bowler's end but misses
Beats everyone! Suyash fires it down leg, full as well. Stoinis shapes to paddle but misses, so does Jitesh
Flatter and quicker on a length on middle and leg, he goes back and punches it through mid-on. It was bowled at 101kph
Full on leg, eased through midwicket. Omarzai charges back and they get two
Quicker one on a length on middle, defensively pushed back to the bowler
Stoinis goes high and long! Sees Krunal drop it on a length, he quickly charges down the track and pummels it over long-off
Slower through the air on leg, clipped through square leg
Fuller and quicker on leg, flicked to midwicket
Loopy full ball on leg, eased down to long-on. Seems like a run has come after some time even though it is just after five balls. Double-wicket over from Suyash

Huge appeal for lbw and given! Musheer reviews. Suyash bowls it shortish on middle and it skids straight on. Musheer gets down for a swipe across the line and wears it around the box. Even umpire's call would be enough for RCB to continue rejoicing. Three reds and PBKS lose Musheer and a review. The evening goes from bad to worse for PBKS
Length ball, googly, picks it late but defends it towards third
Length ball on middle, turned across to the on side
Why did he do that? A wild shot and PBKS are six down. WOW! Flatter googly on the stumps, Shashank goes for an ungainly swing across the line and sees his middle and leg stump disturbed.
ooh, almost through him straight away. Googly on off and middle, he squirts it off the inside half of the bat behind square
Another heave but there is a fielder in the deep now. Was a length ball outside off stump, he gets this to deep midwicket
Banged in short outside off, he sways outside the line
On a good length on off stump, he gets across and ticks this towards midwicket
A touch fuller outside off, he pushes towards cover point for a run
Heaved away for four! On a length outside off, he slogs this through midwicket for a four. PBKS still playing their shots
On a length on off stump, he stays inside the crease as he defends back towards the bowler
A top over from Dayal. Hard length on middle and leg, he pushes this back to the bowler
On a good length angling away from Shashank who cuts this to point
Good length ball on middle stump, he shimmies down and helps this over midwicket for a couple of runs

The leg stump has been flattened and PBKS have lost half their side. Dayal is off on a celebratory run. On a good length shaping back into Wadhera on off. He plays a half-hearted drive, gets a thick inside-edge and sees his stumps in a mess
An expansive cover drive but Salt dives to deep this down to two. Was a fullish length ball outside off, Wadhera laces the drive on the up
Play and a miss again. On a length just outside off, he looks to force this through the offside but misses
Good riposte! Extra bit of bounce and pace. Good length ball that zips through off a good length around off stump. Stoinis was late on the pull
SMASHED! Back of  a length ball on leg stump, he gets across and pulls this for a gigantic six over deep square leg.
Another back of a length ball outside off, he miscues his pull to mid-on
Edgy but gets four. Back of a length ball outside off, he attempts a pull, gets a thick inside-edge that flies past the leg stump
On a good length outside off with a hint of nibble. Stoinis shoulders arms

Top-edge... top-edge and Hazlewood has his second. Oh, my word! This is what RCB missed when Hazlewood wasn't around. He has his second and the PBKS supporters are stunned. Banged in short around the midriff on off, he goes for a pull but is cramped for room. The ball spoons straight up and Bhuvi takes a comfortable catch at deep fine leg
Swung away but only for a run. Was a wayward length ball on his pad but he could maximise it with deep backward square leg getting around
On a good length just outside off, he stands tall and punches to covers
Length on off stump, the ball hits the splice of his bat as he pushes this just past the bowler's left
On a length outside off, he slices this to backward point
Uppish but safe. Was a length ball on his pad, he flicks this to midwicket, who intercepts this to his right
TONKED straight over the bowler's head. First boundary for Wadhera. In the slot outside off, he swings through the line and gets four
Fuller in length just around off, he ticks this to short midwicket. Oops, the sirens go off. Dayal has overstepped.
On a good length on middle and leg, he steps across and works this behind square to get off the mark
Back of a length ball just around off, he looks for a pull, misses and gets hit on the thigh pad

Another edge, another wicket. RCB ARE ON FIRE! PBKS captain Iyer is back in the hut and they are in a world of trouble now. Good length ball outside off, Iyer goes for an ungainly hoick, gets a thick edge and Jites ain't dropping those... not today. Iyer will so desperately want to revisit that shot.
Finds the gap so beautifully. Short of a good length outside off, he punches in between backward point and cover point as Salt chases this and keeps them down to two
Close... close! Feels for the hard length ball outside off stump with an open face of the bat. Is lucky he doesn't get an edge
Good length ball on his hips which he pulls to deep backward square leg for a run

Bhuvi has the last laugh and Kohli is PUMPED! Wowza! PBKS have lost two key batters in three overs. Bhuvi, the experienced Bhuvi shortens his length on off stump. Prabhsimran  jumps down again, goes for an almighty slog, but the ball continues to climb. Prabhsimran can only manage a thin edge and Jitesh does the rest
Short of a good length outside off, he guides this neatly but can't beat short third where Shepherd puts in a dive to his right
Goes over mid-on, this time. Is he chasing Patidar?On a length on middle, he jumps the track again and swings this over mid-on for another four

PUMPED! Charges down the track to the length ball outside off and sends it up and over mid-off. The bat turned in his hand a bit, but he just had to beat the fielder inside the circle and he did that comfortably.
Sliced to deep point. On a length outside off, he gets this down to Salt
On a good length around off stump, Inglis punches this to mid-off
Prabhsimran gets PBKS's six-counter running and Dayal cannot finish the over well. Was a short of a good length ball on his hips, he swivels and helps this over deep backward square leg
BEATEN! Good length ball shaping away from Prabhsimran who feels for it outside off and can't connect

Oof, that is spectacular fielding by Livingstone at deep point. Short and wide, he slaps this with some timing. It was four for all money but Livingstone sprints to his right, dives full-length to his right and saves two
Good stop by Suyash at short third. Given width outside off, first up. Inglis slashes at it and gets a thickish edge that flies to the left of Suyash, who does well.

Dayal gets a wicket second ball. On a length outside off, he creams a cover drive right off the middle of the bat. But, but he doesn't find the placement and Krunal takes a simple catch at cover. Is dejected but has to walk back. RCB have an early strike.
Angles the first ball across Prabhsimran who again runs this neatly past short third with an open face
On a length just outside off, he plays with a slight open face to deep third
Ooh, play and a miss first up. Away-swinger first up pitching on off and moving away late. He feels for it and is lucky to not get an edge
On a length on middle and leg, he works this neatly to deep backward square leg

First boundary of Qualifier 1 and it goes to Arya.Good length ball angling across Arya, and the width is the key. He stands up on his toes and punches to the right of Krunal at backward point. Should he have stopped it? Possibly.
Ooh, some swing for Bhuvi. Length ball that pitches on off and shapes back slightly into Arya. He gets a thick inside-edge onto pad. Was searching for a run but is sent back and rightly so
In the air but in the gap as Arya is away with a couple of runs. Not a lot of movement, initially. On a length on middle and leg, he works this past midwicket

After nine long years, RCB can dream again, they inch ever-so closer to that elusive IPL title. RCB are in the title-clash for the fourth time, not on the back of their powerful batting, but thanks to another strong bowling show.. Patidar gets a full ball in his slog outside leg, he gets down and sends it sailing into the deep midwicket stands to seal an eight-wicket win
Very full on leg, he tugs it through midwicket
Fuller on middle, knocked down to long-off
Up and over. Quicker and fuller on leg, follows Patidar who backs away. But he lofts it inside out over cover to put RCB one hit away
Quicker length ball outside off, slapped to deep cover-point
Fuller on middle, a bit of spin away as Patidar drives it to long-off
Slows it down, on off, punched to cover
Oh Salt, what power on the cut! He bowls it on a length, wide outside off, 84.7kph. Salt waits an extra second and cuts it hard and away from the deep cover-point fielder running to his left
Fuller around off, driven to long-off
Quicker and on middle, goes back and punches it towards forward square leg
Fuller outside off, punched to deep cover-point to bring up a fine half-century. Salt ensured that RCB breathe easy despite Kohli's early fall
On a length on middle and leg, he goes back to clip it through square leg
Quicker and fuller on leg, clipped through backward square leg

Fired fuller down leg, he flicks and it lobs up off Inglis's pad. Iyer jogs in from slip, catches it and appeals. The umpires want to take another look. It was very full and sliding down leg, there is a feather. Not a bump ball, and that is that for Agarwal tonight. Maiden IPL wicket for Musheer, something to cheer for the PBKS fans
Inside out, timing exquisite Wadhera looks to keep it in play with his foot but is unsuccessful. Tossed up full on middle, driven inside out through cover
Languid, six! Floated full on middle, Agarwal leans forward with a half-stride, gets under it and tonks it into the sight-screen, fifty partnership
Nicely looped up, full outside leg, knocked down to long-on
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped through square leg
Floated fuller outside off, nudged through cover-point
Quicker and fuller on off, punched to deep cover
Floated full around off, driven to short cover, who parries it to long-off
Lands it on a length outside off, slashed to deep cover-point
Fetch that! Short but not too short. Salt quickly goes back to rub it into PBKS. Pulls it well over deep midwicket
Lands it on a length on off and middle, he goes back on a knee and sweep[-pulls it through square leg
GOES THE DISTANCE! Jamieson has gone for 21 and RCB are just 41 away. Fuller outside off, he extends his arms and slams this up and over covers. Such sweet timing!
And, again! A few bounces and into the fence. Banged in short just outside off, he pulls off the front foot over midwicket
CRASHED through covers and Salt's assault continues. Too full outside off, he drives on the up and continues his charge

Edged for a couple of runs.  On a length shaping away from Salt well outside off. He throws his hands at it and gets a thick outside edge that goes to Arshdeep's left at deep third. A slight misfield allows them two
On the bounce to deep backward square leg. Length ball on his pad, he flicks this but the ball does not carry to Brar
Mayank backs away but Jamieson follows him. However, that was too straight as Mayank shimmies down and punches this to the right of mid-on
Delicate from Salt and he gets four more. Good length ball outside off, he opens the face of the bat, gets on top of the bounce and runs this fine past short third
On a length shaping away from Salt who opens the face of the bat and guides it past point. They get two

Back of a length ball just outside off, he looks to cut it away and gets an under-edge past his off stump. Was searching for a run and is sent back just in time. And rightly so as Inglis' throw came in swiftly
Short and wide outside off, Salt hammers this over point. That was absolutely shellacked
JAFFA! On a length that pitches on off and shapes away late. Salt has a poke at it and gets beaten. Loud appeal from PBKS, not given. And there is no review
Length ball outside off, he mistimes his push to mid-off

Is that fourth time lucky for Jamieson? PBKS fielders think so. The umpire has given it out! But Mayank has taken the review. Don't think he got anywhere close to it. On a length shaping away from the batter, who pushes at it and gets beaten one more time.
Test match level leave! On a length outside off, he presses forward, watches it closely and shoulders arms
Beaten all ends up! The ball is hooping around, alright. Fuller in length shaping away from Mayank. His feet end up stuck as he shimmies down the track and feebly pushes at it. Gets almost squared up

Goes past the outside edge. The PBKS fielders appeal but can't convince Iyer enough for a review. Lovely good length ball that lands outside off, and continues to shape away. Mayank has a push at it and misses

Edged and taken! Kohli departs and Jamieson is ecstatic. The extra bounce brings about Kohli's undoing. Back of a length ball around sixth stump, shaping away from Kohli. He pokes at it, gets a thick edge and Inglis does the rest. It's a dismissal we have seen so many times, haven't we?
Good length ball on off, he defends towards the bowler
SMACKED deep into the stands. Short of a length ball angling across Salt outside off. He presses forward but that just sat up for Salt to hammer it over deep midwicket. RCB are 30 for 0 after three!
Back of a length ball slanting across Salt who pats this to point
Oh, he's adjusted well there, has Salt. Slower short of a length ball around his ribs cramping him for room on leg stump. He waits for it and gets a tiny top edge that flies over the keeper's head
Banged in short around off stump, he pulls this down towards deep square leg
Back of a length ball angling across Salt who heaves this to deep square leg
They get an overthrow! Good length ball just outside off, he chops this to the keeper and is sent back by Salt. Inglis has a shy at the stumps at the striker's end, misses and they take the run
Back of a length ball outside off, he dabs this to the left of backward point for a quick run
Laces the cover drive, but can't find the gap. Fullish in length outside off, he drives on the up to Stoinis at cover
Play and a miss! On the fuller side shaping away well outside off stump. Kohli feels for it, and gets beaten
He gets that fine and gets another four. PBKS bowlers have been too straight, and Kohli won't miss out there. Good length ball on leg stump, he works this behind square
back of a length ball with a hint of away shape outside off. Salt stays back and works this through square leg
In the slot outside off, he slams the drive on the up but mid-off is fairly wide
Inswing but again the line is too straight. On middle and leg as Salt flicks this to the right of mid-on for a couple of runs as RCB collect 11 of the first over
Length ball on his pad , Kohli works this neatly to deep backward square leg for a run
On a length on the stumps, he defends back to the bowler

Two in two and RCB are away in style. Little bit of shape into Kohli but the line is awry. Starts too straight and ends up going down leg. He flicks this neatly off his pad. Oh, looks like there wasn't any bat involved. The ball clipped his pad.
And he's away with a solid four. Banged in short on off stump, he gets on top of the bounce and thumps the pull through midwicket
Good length ball angling across Salt who pats this past point
